title: CAISO: curtailment against midday prices
subtitle: Each point is a day, 2026-08-27 to 2026-09-25
source_line: Source: CAISO via the Energy Research Warehouse (ERW), tables caiso_curtailment_daily, caiso_rtm_hub_prices; data retrieved to 2026-09-28.
citations: California ISO (CAISO). daily_renewable_report: Daily Renewable Report (curtailment and output). https://www.caiso.com/library/daily-renewable-reports. California ISO (CAISO). production_curtailments: Production and curtailments data (5-minute). https://www.caiso.com/library/production-curtailments-data. Retrieved 2026-09-27 via the Energy Research Warehouse (ERW), table caiso_curtailment_daily, data commit 2c667859235e.

California Independent System Operator (CAISO). PRC_INTVL_LMP: OASIS Interval Locational Marginal Prices, real-time dispatch (RTD, 5-minute). https://oasis.caiso.com/mrioasis/logon.do. Retrieved 2026-09-28 via the Energy Research Warehouse (ERW), table caiso_rtm_hub_prices, data commit 2c667859235e.
facts: CAISO, 2026-08-27 to 2026-09-25 (30 days): the most curtailment in a day was 18362.58 MWh on 2026-09-18, when the mean midday real-time price at TH_SP15_GEN-APND was -3.5 USD/MWh; the correlation of daily curtailment with the midday price over these days was -0.57.
Wind and solar curtailed, 2026-09-19 to 2026-09-25: 28725.99 MWh.

xAxis.name: Wind and solar curtailed, MWh per day

yAxis.name: Mean real-time price 10:00 to 16:00 Pacific, USD/MWh
